name: Za’atar Chicken and Eggplant Bake
subtitle: From Eliza
notes: Make sure to add lots of other vegetables too—mushrooms, onions, zucchini…. You might want a really big pan.

items: 1 Tbsp salt (may want to reduce this a bit and add more later if needed)
3 pounds chicken (breasts or thighs, bone in and skin on—or not. It’s good however you do it)
1 pound eggplant cut into 2-inch chunks (or more)

steps.title: Mix the seasoning
steps.body: Heat the oven to 450°F. Stir together **3 Tbsp Za’atar seasoning**, **1 tsp white sugar**, **1 Tbsp salt** (may want to reduce this a bit and add more later if needed) and **2 tsp black pepper**.

steps.title: Arrange the pan
steps.body: Place **10 medium garlic cloves, peeled** in the center of a rimmed baking sheet. Arrange around the garlic in the pan: **3 pounds chicken** (breasts or thighs, bone in and skin on—or not. It’s good however you do it), **1 pound eggplant cut into 2-inch chunks** (or more) and other vegetables in large quantity.

steps.title: Season and roast
steps.body: Drizzle with extra-virgin olive oil, then sprinkle with the za’atar mixture. You may want to toss at this point, but try to keep the garlic separate, in the middle of the pan. Roast until the chicken reaches 165°F.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: Transfer the chicken and vegetables to a serving dish, then mash the garlic on the baking sheet and add **¼ cup water** and **juice of 1 lemon**.

steps.title: Scrape and serve
steps.body: Scrape up the browned bits with the liquid, then spoon the sauce over the chicken and vegetables and serve.
